learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will master the rules of converting direct quotes into indirect speech, focusing on pronoun shifts, tense backshifting, and changing time/place expressions.]
warm_up_hook: 🗣️ Have you ever passed on a secret message? When you tell someone what another person said, you can't always use their exact words. You have to translate it into 'Reported Speech' to make it make sense today. Let's become expert grammar gossips! 🤫

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When the reporting verb (like 'said') is in the past tense, the tense inside the quotation marks takes one step back into the past. Present Simple becomes Past Simple, Present Continuous becomes Past Continuous, and Past Simple becomes Past Perfect.
examples_or_templates: Direct: He said, 'I work in a bank.'
Indirect: He said that he worked in a bank. (Present Simple -> Past Simple)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Pronouns must change to reflect the perspective of the person reporting the speech. 'I' often becomes 'he/she', 'my' becomes 'his/her', and 'we' becomes 'they'.
examples_or_templates: Direct: She said, 'I lost my favorite pen.'
Indirect: She said that she had lost her favorite pen.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Because the time and place of reporting are different from when the words were originally spoken, time words must shift. 'Now' -> 'then', 'today' -> 'that day', 'tomorrow' -> 'the next day', and 'here' -> 'there'.
examples_or_templates: Direct: 'I will do it tomorrow,' he said.
Indirect: He said that he would do it the next day.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Choose the correct indirect speech for: Raj said, 'I am reading a book.'
options: Raj said that I was reading a book.
Raj said that he is reading a book.
Raj said that he was reading a book.
Raj says that he was reading a book.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: Raj said that he was reading a book.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ How does the word 'yesterday' change in indirect speech?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Convert this sentence into indirect speech: The teacher said to the students, 'You must submit your projects tomorrow.'
subjective_practice.hint: Remember to change the pronoun 'you', the possessive 'your', and the time expression 'tomorrow'.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Convert this interrogative sentence to indirect speech: She asked me, 'Where do you live?'
subjective_practice.hint: For 'Wh-' questions, we don't use 'that'. Keep the question word, but change the sentence structure from a question back to a statement format.

activity_or_assignment.title: 📰 The Celebrity Gossip Columnist
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Find three direct quotes from a famous person (athlete, actor, or historical figure). Write a short 'gossip column' paragraph where you report what they said using indirect speech. Ensure you backshift your tenses correctly!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Backshift tenses one step into the past when the reporting verb is in the past tense.
⭐ Update pronouns to match the perspective of the person reporting the speech.
⭐ Always shift time and place words (e.g., this -> that, today -> that day, here -> there) to fit the new context.
